name: STEP: Seminar for Top Engineering Prospects (Purdue)
org: Purdue University College of Engineering Honors Program
what_you_do: Spend a week on Purdue's campus. You work in teams of four on engineering design challenges. There is a final design competition. You also tour two engineering areas. You learn about 3D modeling, programming and robotics.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors (Class of 2028 for the 2027 camp). Purdue recommends three years of high school math and one year of chemistry or physics by summer.
pay_detail: Attendance fee $2,500. It covers activities, housing, meals and local transportation. You pay your own travel to Purdue. Need-based scholarships are available after you are accepted.
deadline_text: 2027 sessions are July 11 to 17, July 18 to 24, July 25 to 31 and Aug 1 to 7. The page says registration will open in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online. A complete application needs your PSAT, SAT or ACT scores and a transcript. Applications are taken until spots are full, then a waiting list. Questions: step@purdue.edu or 765-494-7217.
notes: Costs money and is a camp, not a job. Only for students going into their senior year.
